params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection. Defaults to 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items per page. Defaults to 10, maximum 100.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to resources created after a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to resources created before a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter products by publication status. Options: any, draft, pending, private, publish.

params.name: on_sale
params.description: Limit results to products on sale when true.

params.name: featured
params.description: Limit results to featured products when true.

params.name: stock_status
params.description: Filter by stock status. Options: instock, outofstock, onbackorder.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of products in the store. Supports filtering by status, category, tag, SKU, featured flag, on-sale flag, price range, stock status, and date ranges. Results are sorted by date by default. Use the page and per_page parameters to paginate through large catalogs.

Creates a new product in the store. Requires at minimum a product name. Products can be simple, grouped, external/affiliate, or variable type. Pricing, stock management, shipping, tax settings, categories, tags, images, and attributes are all configurable at creation time.
Returns the details of a single product identified by its numeric ID. Includes all product properties such as pricing, stock, images, categories, tags, attributes, and metadata.
Updates an existing product identified by its numeric ID. Only the properties included in the request body are updated; omitted properties retain their current values.

params.name: force
params.description: Set to true to permanently delete the resource, bypassing the trash.

items.docs: Deletes a product by its numeric ID. By default the product is moved to the trash. Set the force parameter to true to permanently delete the product and bypass the trash.

info.name: WooCommerce Batch Create, Update, and Delete Products

items.docs: Performs batch create, update, and delete operations on products in a single request. Pass arrays of product objects under the create, update, and delete keys respectively. Delete accepts an array of product IDs.

params.name: calculate_price_range
params.description: Whether to calculate and return the min/max price range.

params.name: calculate_attribute_counts
params.description: Comma-separated list of attribute slugs to count active terms for filter UIs.

params.name: calculate_rating_counts
params.description: Whether to calculate and return review rating counts.

items.docs: Returns aggregate data about a product collection including price ranges, attribute counts, and category counts. Used to populate filter widgets on shop and category archive pages without fetching full product records.
